Job Description :

1. Plan and achieve production targets while ensuring product quality and quantity.

2. ⁠Lead, monitor, and evaluate Plant team performance, including people development.

3. ⁠Monitor Plant costs, investments, and operational development to support efficiency.

4. ⁠Analyze operational issues and develop effective strategies, initiatives, and continuous improvements.

5. ⁠Ensure a safe, healthy, and conducive work environment in compliance with K3 and 5S standards.

Qualifications :

1. Minimum Bachelor’s (S1) degree in Mechanical/Electrical/Mechanics/Industrial Engineering.

2. ⁠Have minimum 3 years of experience as Plant Manager in the same industry or 5 years in a different industry. Or have minimum 6 years of experience as Production/ME Supervisor.

3. ⁠Strong leadership, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
4. Proficient in English (verbal and written) is mandatory and Mandarin proficiency is an advantage.

5. ⁠Willing to be placed in Medan.




Deskripsi Pekerjaan :

1. Merencanakan dan mencapai target produksi dengan memastikan kualitas dan kuantitas produk.

2. ⁠Memimpin, memonitor, dan mengevaluasi kinerja tim Plant serta mengembangkan SDM.

3. ⁠Mengelola biaya, investasi, dan pengembangan operasional Plant.

4. ⁠Menganalisis permasalahan operasional serta mengembangkan strategi, inisiatif, dan inovasi secara berkelanjutan.

5. ⁠Memastikan lingkungan kerja yang aman, sehat, dan kondusif sesuai dengan standar K3 dan 5S.

Kualifikasi :

1. Minimal sarjana (S1) di jurusan Teknik Mesin/Elektro/Mekatronika/ Industri.

2. ⁠Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun sebagai Plant Manager di industri yang sama atau 5 tahun di industri berbeda. Atau, memiliki pengalaman minimal 6 tahun sebagai Supervisor Produksi/ME.

3. ⁠Memiliki kemampuan leadership, analitis, dan problem solving yang baik.
4. Memiliki kemampuan Bahasa Inggris secara lisan dan tulisan (wajib) serta kemampuan Bahasa Mandarin (menjadi nilai tambah).

5. ⁠Bersedia ditempatkan di Medan.

JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.
